searchConsole.interpretation: These reports do not rule out automated ranking changes or guarantee future eligibility.

policyAssessment.scaledContentAndDoorways: The meaningful residual risk for this directory. Retained the existing 84 canonical content pages, 62 indexable pages, and 463 permanent-content-consolidation redirect destinations. Sparse records remain concise hub entries; no new keyword, city or filter landing pages generated in this pass. Original menu comparisons and calculators add practical value but do not guarantee a Google quality assessment.
policyAssessment.cloaking: No request-user-agent content branch found in reviewed app/components/lib. Rendered search variants were compared with a Googlebot user-agent and the same visible main content was returned. This is a scoped regression check, not a full server/security audit.
policyAssessment.linkSpam: Reviewed the domains linked from exported content and utility pages. No unexpected URL schemes in 86 non-redirect HTML files. No purchased-link or sponsored-placement mechanism found in the reviewed templates. This is not a backlink-profile audit.
policyAssessment.structuredData: Existing whole-inventory audit rejects imported AggregateRating/Review data and invalid JSON-LD. No fabricated first-hand reviews or venue imagery added.
policyAssessment.freshness: Removed build timestamps and restaurant source-check dates from sitemap lastmod. Optional lastmod remains omitted until meaningful page edits can be dated reliably.
policyAssessment.searchVariants: Removed robots.txt blocks that prevented reading search/filter noindex. Search stays absent from sitemap and canonicalizes to /search.
policyAssessment.sourceWarnings: Unresolved source warnings now also appear on compact restaurant cards used by style and feature pages.

ongoingEditorialRequirements: Do not automatically publish additional standalone city/restaurant pages based on word count or uniqueness scores.
Keep new guides focused on a distinct useful decision supported by venue-specific evidence.
Recheck source facts when due; do not rewrite dates to make unchanged content look newer.
Treat meals, prices, availability and source failures separately, retaining corrections and provenance.
Do not buy ranking links or publish unrelated sponsored pages.
Compare actual Search Console page/query changes if rankings fall; do not assume every decline is a spam penalty.
limitations: No guarantee against future spam or core updates.
No full backlink audit, security penetration test, or new independent recheck of all 413 restaurant records.
Existing unresolved menu/branch evidence remains documented in review.json.
Changes are not on the public domain yet.
